BiblicalUsage: Gamliel son of Pedahzur was the prince of the tribe of Manasseh in the wilderness. He is named among the princes in Numbers 1:10, and he was over the host of Manasseh when the tribes set out in Numbers 10:23. His name means my reward is God, and he led his tribe through the desert.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the princes of the wilderness matter because they carried the tribes. Gamliel led Manasseh by God's order, and I hold that faithful leadership in a desert is as great as leadership in a palace.
